prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective of someone walking along a dimly lit path at night in Le Prarion, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the faint outlines of trees and shrubs on either side of the narrow trail. As the person progresses, the camera angle remains fixed, providing a consistent view of the path ahead. The sky above is dotted with stars, faintly visible through the cloudy and foggy conditions, casting a soft, ambient light over the scene. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with only the subtle glow from distant sources illuminating parts of the path and vegetation. The camera occasionally shifts slightly to the left and right, revealing more of the dense foliage and the uneven terrain underfoot. Despite the low visibility, the steady pace of the walker suggests a familiar route, with no sudden movements or changes in direction. The overall atmosphere is quiet and serene, with the natural sounds of the night blending into the peaceful solitude of the outdoor setting.
